title: Safety inspection checklist
summary: Every month, a safety inspection checklist task for each site with Pass / Fail buttons; failures raise a corrective action and are logged.
description:
Safety inspection checklist runs your monthly workplace inspections without paper forms. On the first of each month the workflow reads the Inspection sites table and starts a Site inspection sub-workflow for every site marked Inspect monthly.

Each inspection is a checklist task form: sixteen yes/no checks grouped under fire safety, housekeeping, equipment and first aid headings with dividers, in a compact two-column grid, plus findings and a photo link. Pass records the result; Fail counts the failed checks, records them in the Inspections table, flags the site, emails the site manager and raises a corrective action task due in a week, which can be completed or sent back for re-inspection.

The main run gives the health and safety lead a sign-off task for the round, so the committee gets one summary each month. Reminders and escalation to the manager keep inspections on time. Everything is built in.
start: Scheduled: 07:00 on the first of every month (Pacific/Auckland; change it on the trigger). Run it manually to start a round now.

changelog.notes: Steps for the coordinator who set the package up are assigned to the workflow owner (workflow_owner_id), now that workflow_started_by names the person who started the run.

setup: Nothing is required: install it and the monthly schedule starts. The installer (the safety lead) receives the inspection, corrective action and sign-off tasks.
Replace the sample rows in Inspection sites with your sites and site managers; untick Inspect monthly for sites you inspect less often.
Edit the checklist on the "Inspect the site" step of the Site inspection workflow to match your site types.
Optional: route inspections to a group of inspectors, change the schedule, and set EMAIL_PROVIDER for the failure emails.

steps.title: Monthly schedule
steps.body: On the 1st, every site marked Inspect monthly gets its own Site inspection run.

steps.title: Checklist
steps.body: The inspector ticks sixteen checks under four headings, adds findings and photos, and clicks Pass or Fail.

steps.title: Record
steps.body: The result, inspection date and number of failed checks go into the Inspections table and onto the site.

steps.title: Corrective action
steps.body: A failure emails the site manager and raises a corrective action due in seven days, with a reminder.

steps.title: Sign off
steps.body: The safety lead signs off the month's round with a summary for the committee.
